summary: Executed public API regression tests and mobile web smoke/full-flow checks. Root, sort, and audio validation passed; task generation had one provider-rate-limit 502 then succeeded on retry. Speak, recording interaction, task screen, delayed Start, and Telugu task rendering were verified.

critical.issue: Returned HTTP 502 when the configured LLM provider returned 429 concurrent_request_limit. This is exposed to clients as a generic Gemini request failure.

integration_issues.issue: Flow is dependent on provider availability; a provider 429 returns to Speak with an error rather than retry/backoff. Successful retry produced a valid task.

action_items: Investigate provider concurrency/rate-limit handling and consider bounded retry or clearer 429/503 mapping for AI calls.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend BACKEND_URL correctly uses the configured public environment value (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in this workspace).
PostHog tracking is safely skipped with an empty key.
Interactive controls have testIDs and minimum touch sizing; no horizontal overflow observed at 375px.

success_rate.backend: 67% (2/3 tests; task test failed once due provider 429)
success_rate.frontend: 80% (Speak/mic/task flow passed; fresh-context dependent completion flow not independently replayed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: A successful browser run reached thing-screen with Telugu task 'Leave apply cheyadam' and the Start control. A fresh context returned to Speak, so completion was not replayed in that run.
rca_of_issue: Backend logs show LiteLLM/OpenAI-compatible provider returned 429 concurrent_request_limit; run_gemini catches it and converts it to HTTP 502. This is an upstream concurrency limitation rather than invalid request JSON. One later request succeeded. No mocked APIs were used.
